title: Disposable face masks used during Covid have left chemical timebomb, research suggests
summary: At height of pandemic 129bn were being used every month around the world, with no recycling stream The surge in the use of disposable face masks during the Covid pandemic has left a chemical timebomb that could harm humans, animals and the environment, research suggests. Billions of tonnes of plastic face masks created to protect people from the spread of the virus are now breaking down, releasing microplastics and chemical additives including endocrine disruptors, the research found. title: US supreme court allows Trump to remove Democrat from FTC post for now
summary: Court’s action gives the justices additional time to consider Trump’s formal request to let him fire Rebecca Slaughter US politics live – latest updates The US supreme court allowed Donald Trump on Monday to keep a Democratic member of the Federal Trade Commission away from her post for now, temporarily pausing a judicial order that required the reinstatement of the commissioner who the Republican president has sought to oust. The court’s action, known as an administrative stay, gives the justices additional time to consider Trump’s formal request to let him fire Rebecca Slaughter from the consumer protection agency that enforces antitrust law prior to her term expiring.
